text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—It's almost time for the unedited 
broadcast of "Horse Girl Detective: First 
Squad".

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...No, no! It's already bedtime! As a 
paragon of justice, staying up late is 
strictly out of the question!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However... it is its first public 
broadcast in over 30 years. There's no 
guarantee of a rerun.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Kh! Why are you wavering, Fenomeno! 
Sleep without watching it, the answer is 
already obvious—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
............I, watched it. To commit such 
a blunder as oversleeping again—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Meno. Heard you barely made it to 
class before the bell today. That's pretty 
rare for you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah, Mame-chin~? Who was it that 
said, "As students devoted to racing and 
academics, arrive with plenty of time to 
spare!" again~?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! Oversleeping in the end was truly 
this officer's failure.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However! I will never make the mistake of 
giving in to temptation ever again! As a 
protector of peace in this academy, I must 
adhere strictly to a disciplined routine!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, hey, Nakayama. Golshi-chan just 
had a thought, y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm thinking the exact same thing. 
It's that, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Even this straight-laced girl gives in to 
temptation depending on what it is. So if 
we corrupt her bit by bit like this—

text_block_list.name: Golshi & Nakayama
text_block_list.text: It'll definitely be hilarious!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Lookie, lookie, looook. It's a 
limited-edition jumbo red bean bun tower~ 
Packed with the chunky bean paste 
Mame-chin loves so much~

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
C-Cease this at once! I am currently 
managing my weight for mock races!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Can only eat it now, y'know? Loaded with 
whole chunky beans~ Even the Hokkaido 
adzuki bean farmers and their whole 
families are in tears, begging you to eat 
it~

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Kh...! Even if you appeal to emotion, this 
officer's resolve... will not waver!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't force it~. To help you be honest 
with yourself, I brought along the bean 
farmer's only son☆ Takeshi-kun, you want 
Mame-chin to eat it, don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
T-Takeshi-kun?! Kh, such innocent eyes! 
Curse you, what a dastardly tactic...!! 
Yet I cannot yield here...!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There's a little "game" going on further 
back. The kind that showed up in that 
detective drama you love. Wanna give it a 
shot just once?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What?! Taking part in such shady 
activities is something this officer 
refuses to do under any circumstances!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Relax. The stakes are just snacks, nothing 
shady at all. If you're hesitating—just 
treat it as an undercover investigation. 
Wanna experience the thrill of high-stakes 
mind games together?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
U-Undercover investigation... If that's 
the case—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
N-No!! "If you dabble even a little, 
you'll never get out" ...My father taught 
me that long ago!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I firmly refuse, sir!! As someone who 
upholds the peace of this town and 
embodies justice, I intend to walk the 
path of righteousness!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...That's some admirable resolve. But can 
someone who only acts pure without knowing 
the underworld of society... truly protect 
peace in the real sense?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ugh!! B-But... this officer still 
cannot...!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... The devil's whispers have been 
hounding me since morning again...
choice_data_list:
Is something wrong? You look really worn 
out.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san and Nakayama-san have been 
laying out irresistible temptations day 
after day.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However! On this officer's pride, I shall 
not be led astray by sweet words—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oi, oi, oi! Did ya hear that, Mame-chin?! 
They're shooting *Bayside Shakedown* over 
there! Isn't that crazy awesome?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wanna sneak outta the academy and 
check it out? An opportunity like this 
don't come around often, right?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What on earth are you saying?! Private 
outings during these hours are strictly 
prohibited!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ain't no problem if we get back quick. 
C'mon, it's a once-in-a-lifetime chance. 
Miss it now, and there won't be a second 
time.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Guh, guuuughhhhhh!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: N-N-NOOOOO!!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
This officer! On my personal pride!! Will 
not succumb to any manner of temptation, 
sirrr!!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ab... so... lute... ly—
choice_data_list:
Are you okay?! You're swaying on your 
feet!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Suffering a dizzy spell... How 
thoroughly disgraceful for an officer. I 
have caused you unwarranted trouble.
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it, more importantly—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While earnestness is a virtue, bottling up 
too much is bad. I advised her that giving 
in to her inner desires once in a while 
might help prevent stress from 
accumulating.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. However, I am uncertain if 
this officer can pull it off properly.
choice_data_list: Try being freer, like Gold Ship.

Try loosening up your shoulders, like 
Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san, you say? Is she not somewhat 
excessively unrestrained—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
'Sup, Mame-chiiin! Brought Excalibur as a 
get-well gift~! Let's go exterminate 
Gorgogonga~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what? You wanna become Golshi-chan? 
Golshi Cram School is always open on prime 
real estate on Saturn, y'know! Don't 
forget your monthly tuition!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ghhhhhh!! As expected, taking cues from 
such an outrageous person is utterly out 
of the question, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Halt right there, Golshi-san! For the 
crime of bringing hazardous contraband 
into the infirmary, you are hereby placed 
under arreeeest!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Understood... In order to prevent exposing 
such blunders in the future, letting off 
some steam once in a while is indeed a 
necessity.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at that. You seem surprisingly 
full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Here, a get-well gift. See ya.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A tin of fruit drops, is it...? I shall 
gladly accept your goodwill. Down the 
hatch...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
GGGHHHHH!! Nakayama-san!! What is this?! 
The entire tin is filled with nothing but 
peppermint drops!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heheh! Savor every last bit of 'em!
